info.name: Razorpay Bills X Fund Accounts API

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Filter by contact ID to list fund accounts linked to that contact.

params.name: account_type
params.description: Filter by fund account type: `bank_account`, `vpa`, `card`, or `wallet`.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of fund accounts to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of fund accounts to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

items.docs: List fund accounts linked to contacts. Filter by contact ID and/or account type.

Create a bank account, VPA, card, or wallet (Amazon Pay) fund account linked to a contact. Fund accounts are immutable after creation. Returns existing record if contact_id + account details all match.

params.name: fund_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the fund account (e.g. `fa_00000000000001`).

items.docs: Fetch details of a specific fund account by its ID.

info.name: Activate or deactivate a fund account

params.name: fund_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the fund account (e.g. `fa_00000000000001`).

items.docs: Activate or deactivate a fund account. Fund account details are immutable — only the `active` status can be changed.
